source.name: Sunderland AFC – 'Sunderland AFC and Shuffle join forces in new global sleeve partnership'
source.quote: Sunderland AFC is delighted to announce Shuffle as the Club’s new Official Sleeve Partner in a multi-year partnership.

note: Multi-year sleeve deal announced 11 September 2026; the Shuffle logo debuted on the first-team shirts in the home match against Arsenal on 12 September 2026. Covers the Premier League, FA Cup, League Cup and Europa League. Value not disclosed.
